summary: In this first-person fiction excerpt, the narrator is drawn blood by an unnamed man who claims it is a free medical screening, then asks to see Sarah, whom she is worried about. He promises to have Marcelina take her downstairs. The narrator grows drowsy, realizes the injection was not for blood, and collapses into a drugged, tunnel-like haze. In a dreamscape, a giant Melania butterfly tells her she is special and that together they will create life, and his face shifts into a jaguar's mask.
one_line: A drugged narrator, separated from Sarah, falls into a hallucinatory dream of a giant butterfly and jaguar in Book 3, part 152.
key_facts: The narrator's arm is held firmly while a man plunges a needle into a vein to draw blood.
The man describes the blood draw as a "free medical screening" and says he is running a batch of tests that afternoon.
The narrator looks at a bowl of broth the man brought and decides she will find something in the kitchen later.
The narrator tells the man, "I want to go down and see Sarah," and says, "I'm very worried about her."
The man says he will send Marcelina to take the narrator to Sarah as soon as Marcelina finishes downstairs.
The man suggests the narrator unpack first, then leaves as quietly as he came.
The narrator wants to take Sarah and fly away like the birds outside the slatted window.
The narrator realizes the needle was not to take blood and that she suspected a drug but he was too fast.
She tries the door, finds it locked, and bangs her head against it, but the room keeps swirling.
She glimpses Sarah at the end of a tunnel, wearing a white shift, but when she reaches for her all she touches is empty mist.
In the dream, a Melania butterfly the size of a man has orange and black wings and a voice described as mellifluous and hypnotic.
The butterfly says, "Your body is a realm of fertility," and "You are special."
His face then evolves into the orange and black mask of a jaguar, who says, "Together we will create life."
The excerpt ends with the narrator questioning whether he said "special".

entities.name: Sarah
entities.role: the person the narrator wants to see and is worried about; she is glimpsed at the end of the tunnel in a white shift

entities.name: Marcelina
entities.role: the person who will be sent to take the narrator downstairs to see Sarah

entities.name: Melania butterfly
entities.role: a giant orange and black butterfly in the narrator's dream who calls her special and says they will create life together

entities.name: jaguar
entities.role: the orange and black jaguar mask the butterfly's face evolves into in the dream
